title: All Tied Up
statementMd:
FIFA is organizing a football tournament with a group stage. One group contains 𝑛n national teams, numbered from 11 to 𝑛n. Each pair of teams in the group will play exactly once.

A win awards 33 points to the winning team and 00 to the losing team. A draw awards 11 point to each team.

Your friend Pedro claims that this group will be so evenly matched that all 𝑛n teams will finish the group stage tied on exactly 𝑘k points. You want to find out whether this is possible.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/470446d9e87c052354f95f73fe9961dd71a003a5.png)*"Stoppage time: until they equalize!"*

Given 𝑛n and 𝑘k, determine whether results can be assigned to the 𝑛(𝑛−1)2n(n−1)2 matches so that every team finishes with exactly 𝑘k points. If so, print any set of results that demonstrates this.

## Input

The input consists of a single line containing two integers 𝑛n and 𝑘k (3≤𝑛≤5003≤n≤500, 0≤𝑘≤3𝑛−30≤k≤3n−3), the number of teams and the desired final score of each team, respectively.

## Output

If it is impossible for every team to finish with exactly 𝑘k points, print `-1` on a single line.

Otherwise, print exactly 𝑛(𝑛−1)2n(n−1)2 lines, one per match. Each line must have the form 𝑎 𝑠 𝑏a s b, where 𝑎a and 𝑏b (1≤𝑎,𝑏≤𝑛1≤a,b≤n, 𝑎≠𝑏a≠b) are teams and 𝑠s is one of the symbols >>, ==, or <<.

Each pair of teams must appear on exactly one line. The symbols mean:

- >>: team 𝑎a beat team 𝑏b;
- <<: team 𝑎a lost to team 𝑏b;
- ==: the match ended in a draw.

You may print the matches in any order. If several valid answers exist, print any of them.
